2609.27009.title: LEGO: Synergizing Expert GraphRAG and Expert Chain-of-Thought for Legal Reasoning
2609.27009.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly applied to high-risk domains such as law, yet complex legal reasoning remains limited by two structural challenges. First, existing RAG and GraphRAG methods emphasize lexical or semantic similarity while overlooking normative relations among legal provisions. Second, vanilla Chain-of-Thought prompting may generate plausible rationales without enforcing the normative structure of legal reasoning. To deal with the bottleneck of pipelines in the legal reasoning domain, we propose LEGO, a dual-module framework that synergizes Legal Expert GraphRAG and expert Chain-of-thought for complex legal reasoning. ExpertGraphRAG uses an expert-annotated civil code graph encoding these normative relations with a greedy normative-coverage retrieval algorithm to dynamically extract instance-specific provision subgraphs, while ExpertCoT organizes the retrieved provisions and case facts into structured Provision-Fact-Conclusion reasoning. With a Qwen3-8B backbone, LEGO achieves 40.53% exact-match accuracy on LawExamQA_Civil, outperforming the evaluated RAG and CoT baselines and performing comparably to the evaluated larger models, while remaining robust on multi-hop questions. It also achieves the best results among the evaluated baselines on the open-ended benchmarks. Ablation studies confirm the individual and complementary contributions of both modules, demonstrating LEGO's effectiveness in improving LLMs' complex legal reasoning ability. Code and dataset can be found in the link: https://github.com/BLK-WHT/LEGO
2609.27009.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地應用於高風險領域，如法律，但複雜的法律推理仍然受到兩個結構性挑戰的限制。首先，現有的RAG和GraphRAG方法強調詞彙或語義相似性，而忽略了法律條款之間的規範關係。其次，普通的Chain-of-Thought提示可能會生成看似合理的推理，但並未強化法律推理的規範結構。為了解決法律推理領域中管道的瓶頸，我們提出了LEGO，一個雙模塊框架，協同法律專家GraphRAG和專家Chain-of-thought以進行複雜的法律推理。ExpertGraphRAG使用專家標註的民法典圖，編碼這些規範關係，並採用貪婪的規範覆蓋檢索算法動態提取特定實例的條款子圖，而ExpertCoT則將檢索到的條款和案例事實組織成結構化的條款-事實-結論推理。使用Qwen3-8B作為骨幹，LEGO在LawExamQA_Civil上達到了40.53%的精確匹配準確率，超越了評估的RAG和CoT基準，並且在多跳問題上表現穩健，與評估的較大模型表現相當。它在開放式基準測試中也在評估的基準中取得了最佳結果。消融研究確認了兩個模塊的個別和互補貢獻，證明了LEGO在提高大型語言模型複雜法律推理能力方面的有效性。代碼和數據集可以在以下鏈接找到：https://github.com/BLK-WHT/LEGO
